_comment: Custom Bekaert Fencing theme v4: vc-frontend 2.51.1 built from source. Barlow typeface (BekaertText is Bekaert's proprietary font, not redistributable); brand preset default/assets/presets/bekaert.json (primary #01ADEF, accent #FF602C); pill buttons; light utility bar; hero copy overlaid left with a CTA; category strip as a card carousel with arrows below; fullscreen catalog dropdown instead of a flat category row.
